clause: Warp family: warp, puppet warp, perspective warp, liquify [STU-RAS-029]

scope.summary: Implement the mesh/warp reshaping primitives on layers, selections, and placed-asset containers: Warp (grid/handle mesh warp with warp presets and custom control-point deformation, including bezier mesh warp); Puppet warp (pin-and-deform mesh with density and expansion); Perspective warp (multi-plane perspective reshaping/correction, single- and dual-plane); Liquify (localized mesh push-forward/left, twirl, pinch, punch, turbulence, mesh-clone, reconstruct brushes, with freeze/thaw masking). Mesh math runs in studio-engine.
proof_targets: mesh warp + liquify freeze/thaw runtime + snapshot
expected_tests: live: apply a mesh warp preset and a custom control-point deformation; puppet-warp pins deform a shape; liquify push-forward brush with a frozen region leaves the frozen area unchanged
test: reconstruct brush restores warped mesh toward original
acceptance_criteria_original: warp/puppet-warp/perspective-warp/liquify with presets + custom control points
liquify brushes + freeze/thaw masking + reconstruct proven

target_entries: Studio / Raster / Warp, puppet warp & liquify

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-029]** Studio MUST provide the following deduped transform and reshaping primitives on layers, selections, and placed-asset containers. Numeric and handle-based input MUST both be supported, and every transform MUST carry explicit typed units per [STU-DOC-003]. *Derivation: catalogue table, splits per row; yields 10 microtasks, one per transform primitive.* | Transform primitive | Normative behavior | |---|---| | Move | Moves selection or layer content, with auto-select and layer-bounds hover options. | | Crop | Crops/expands canvas with ratio and absolute presets, overlay guides, straighten, delete-vs-hide cropped pixels, crop-to-selection, and content-aware fill of newly exposed areas on commit. | | Perspective crop | Crops while correcting keystoned perspective to a straight-on rectangle via corner handles. | | Free transform | Scale, rotate, skew, distort, and flip in one interactive operation with numeric entry and reference-point control. | | Warp | Grid/handle mesh warp with warp presets and custom control-point deformation, including bezier mesh warp. | | Puppet warp | Pin-and-deform mesh with density and expansion controls for organic reshaping. | | Perspective warp | Multi-plane perspective reshaping/correction (single- and dual-plane). | | Content-aware scale | Scales while protecting flagged content from distortion using a protection mask/channel. | | Content-aware fill | Fills a selection by synthesizing plausible pixels from sampled source regions ([STU-RAS-143]). | | Liquify | Localized mesh push-forward, push-left, twirl, pinch, punch, turbulence, mesh-clone, and reconstruct brushes, with freeze/thaw masking. |

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
